scope.basis: Only listed public source/README/tests and the documented in-memory public-API probe. No acceptance results used.

findings.title: CSV export does not reject invalid status
findings.evidence: export_csv passes status directly to repository.search and never calls _status; list_tasks calls _status(status, optional=True) at line38. An unknown status therefore selects no rows and reaches write_tasks instead of raising ValueError.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate optional status before searching or opening the destination; add a public regression that invalid status raises and does not create/overwrite the destination.

findings.title: Export-all implementation has an arbitrary one-million-row limit
findings.evidence: repository.search is called with limit=1000000. That is larger than normal listing limits but still truncates a larger matching dataset.
findings.verification: source inspection; no million-row dataset created
findings.suggestedFix: Provide an uncapped or correctly batched export path with the shared filters and deterministic order. Add a practical public >100-row regression to cover the explicitly described listing/export distinction.

findings.title: Python query lowercasing changes non-ASCII literal query characters
findings.evidence: Python query.lower() transforms É to é; SQLite LOWER(title) leaves É unchanged. With separate Éclair/id1 and éclair/id2 tasks, query É returns id2 instead of literal id1.
findings.verification: public TaskService API, in-memory SQLite, bytecode writing disabled
findings.suggestedFix: Apply only ASCII-insensitive comparison while preserving other literal characters, identically in listing/count/export, and add exact non-ASCII query regressions.

strengths: Uses real on-disk SQLite with temporary directories.
Original tests cover durable status, AND filters and timestamp ties.
Added export test checks CSV fields and commas/quotes using csv.reader on newline-preserving streams.
CLI test invokes the public main(argv), captures JSON and verifies output file without subprocesses.

gaps.detail: Pagination-named test never supplies limit or offset, never filters, and reads all3 rows. It does not verify filter-before-paging, totals independent of paging, multiple pages or offsets beyond the end.
Literal-query additions cover only %. Missing underscore, backslash, quotes, ASCII casing and preserved non-ASCII literal cases.

Export coverage uses only3/4 tasks. Missing >100 rows, invalid status, query+status export filters, empty header-only export, direct serialize/write_tasks contracts, and service/writer row-count assertions.
Special-character CSV test has commas/quotes but no embedded newline or Unicode title. No raw-byte assertions for no BOM/LF record terminators.
CLI export coverage is one unfiltered task; does not exercise shared query/status filter semantics.

suggestedPublicFollowUp:
Public README/source review found three remaining contract gaps. TaskService.export_csv must reject invalid status before writing, just as list_tasks does. It must export all matches without the arbitrary limit=1000000 ceiling. In repository._where, query.lower() applies Unicode case folding while SQLite LOWER only folds ASCII; preserve non-ASCII literal characters while making ASCII letters case-insensitive. For example, with titles Éclair and éclair, query É must match the first, not the second.

Extend only tests/test_regressions.py with focused tests for those cases and the README requirements currently uncovered: real limit/offset pages with filtered totals and tied timestamps; literal %, _, backslash and quote queries; exports beyond 100 tasks; empty exports; exact multiline/Unicode CSV round trips, row counts, UTF-8 without BOM and LF records; and filtered CLI export. Exercise the CLI by calling tracker.cli.main(argv) in process and capturing stdout; do not spawn subprocesses. Keep exact title assertions and parse CSV through a stream opened with newline="" or io.StringIO, preserving embedded newlines. Preserve original tests, README, __init__.py, public signatures, parameterized SQL and the existing scope. Re-read current hashes before edits, run the same exact prescribed unittest command under the existing read-only command policy, inspect its output, and summarize only observed results.
limits: This is a bounded public-contract review, not an independent acceptance verdict. The only executed probe used TaskService with an in-memory database; public unit tests were inspected but not run. Frozen workspace file hashes were rechecked unchanged before saving this report.
